**MPs (excluding Conservatives, Labour or Liberal Democrats) who voted “aye” on *all three* Animal‑Welfare‑related divisions that took place on 14 March 2022**

| MP | Party (as recorded on Parliament’s vote pages) |
|----|----------------------------------------------|
| Stephen Farry | Alliance |
| Gregory Campbell | Democratic Unionist Party |
| Carla Lockhart | Democratic Unionist Party |
| Gavin Robinson | Democratic Unionist Party |
| Jim Shannon | Democratic Unionist Party |
| Sammy Wilson | Democratic Unionist Party |
| Caroline Lucas | Green Party |
| Ben Lake | Plaid Cymru |
| Liz Saville Roberts | Plaid Cymru |

**Why these nine are the only ones**

* **Division 213** (14 Mar 2022, “New Clause 1”) – the vote‑record (link above) lists the Ayes as Stephen Farry, the five DUP MPs, Caroline Lucas, Ben Lake and Liz Saville Roberts.  
* **Division 214** (14 Mar 2022, “New Clause 3”) – the vote‑record lists the same Ayes plus an Independent (Margaret Ferrier) and 33 SNP MPs, but the same nine names remain present.  
* **Division 215** (14 Mar 2022, “New Clause 5”) – the vote‑record again lists those nine names as Ayes, along with a different Independent (Anne Marie Morris) and two Alba MPs.

Because each of the nine MPs appears in the Ayes list for all **three** divisions, they are the only MPs (outside the Conservative, Labour, and Liberal Democrat benches) who voted “aye” on every Animal‑Welfare vote that day.

**Sources**

* Division 213 – “Animal Welfare (Sentience) Bill [Lords] Report Stage: New Clause 1” – Ayes list includes the nine MPs【commentary: https://votes.parliament.uk/Votes/Commons/Division/1249】.  
* Division 214 – “Animal Welfare (Sentience) Bill [Lords] Report Stage: New Clause 3” – identical Ayes list【commentary: https://votes.parliament.uk/Votes/Commons/Division/1250】.  
* Division 215 – “Animal Welfare (Sentience) Bill [Lords] Report Stage: New Clause 5” – identical Ayes list【commentary: https://votes.parliament.uk/Votes/Commons/Division/1251】.
